title: California Schedule A (540) Itemized Deductions — 2024
rationale: California itemized deductions are computed on Schedule CA (540), Part II. Charitable contributions total $23,000 ($8,000 cash + $15,000 appreciated stock). No medical expenses, taxes, mortgage interest, or other itemized deductions were provided. The $23,000 total exceeds the California MFJ standard deduction of $11,080, so itemizing wins. Federal AGI is below the MFJ limitation threshold ($489,719), so itemized deductions are not reduced.
